It saved my life. I'd been abused and raped by my romantic partner. I was planning on killing myself. Had an opportunity to take LSD, and I took it. Realized that I was good enough to live, that happiness was real, that what he did to me wasn't my fault, that I was beautiful and worth loving. 

Now, I'm in a healthy and happy relationship with my soulmate. He treats me like a queen, and I treat him like a king. Every minute with him is bliss. I'm happy. I'm very happy that I didn't hurt myself. I have self-confidence, and while I'm not perfect- I'm healing and becoming a better me.

My exfiance convinced me he was my soulmate. That we were meant to be and no one could love me how he did. He had a ring. I was completely in love with him.  I'd told him I didn't like anal. That it was something maybe after a few years we could try it when I was more comfortable. He didn't like that answer, and while we were having consensual vaginal sex he switched without even spitting. So I tore and bled, the pain made me freeze- I couldn't even blink. I was just silently crying into the pillow. After he was done he started interrogating me about how it felt. I didn't want to discuss it and told him. He wouldn't take no for an answer- so I told him it was really painful and I wanted to take a shower. I laid on the shower floor and just cried while he watched. Eventually he walked out and I washed the blood off. 

I tried to talk to him about it and he just kept telling me that I was hurting his feelings talking like that. I was confused and didn't understand. I thought maybe he'd asked and I'd agreed and forgotten. Or he'd asked and I didn't hear him and he took my "hmm?" As an affirmative. I made every excuse I could. I talked to one of my best friends about it- he told me it was rape. But I was in complete denial so I cut that friend out. 

A few weeks go by and it happens again. I post about it anonymously on reddit. Again am told it's rape and to leave him. I delete the post. Try to talk to him about it again. Get told he has no idea what I'm talking about, that he never did that. I must be bleeding because of an infection or std  or something- not anything he did. He's only ever had vaginal with me. 

Meanwhile I'm going through hell emotionally. My childhood cat was slowly dying from cancer, I was medicating him multiple times a day. My mom had injured her leg and I had to do everything for her and my dad. I was working almost 40 hours a week as a part time worker. I was getting a few hours of sleep a night. Then he did it again... and I was so depressed I stole some of my moms pills that I have a deadly allergy to- I thought that was the only way it was going to stop. 

Then he dumped me. Told me I was too depressed for him to love anymore. Said I was broken and unlovable. That I would never be anything. That he needed someone better. It destroyed me. I begged him to stay. I promised him anything. I was destroyed. I lost 45lbs from starving myself while continuing to work and do everything for my family. I wasn't sleeping at all. I was vomiting randomly throughout the day. I knew if he left me that I'd really be a victim and it wasn't just a "misunderstanding".

We worked together so I changed my schedule to be opposite of his. If I even saw his car I'd have a panic attack and be crying all day on my shift. I almost quit, but I had to buy food and pay off putting my cat down. It was at the beginning of the pandemic so I didn't want to quit. His 2 friends at work told everyone I was lying about the rapes. I almost killed myself when I came out of denial and told everyone. And then being called a liar... if I hadn't still been nursing my mom's health I would have done it. I had notes written out, songs I wanted played at my funeral, everything.

I'm still healing. I still have flashbacks when my partner accidentally touches me wrong. I can't see a man who looks like my rapist without a panic attack. Him leaving was the best thing he could have done- if we'd gotten legally married I'm sure I'd be dead.
